set.body:
Promote the existing fit chunk machinery into a reusable ChunkProgram abstraction: ordered iterable work units, scheduler-neutral interpreters, typed partial results, and deterministic reducers.

Acceptance: current voxel chunking behavior is preserved; sequential and Future interpreters remain order-preserving; failures carry chunk identity; the abstraction can later host subject, contrast, group, and export fan-out without depending on Spark or JVM-only schedulers.
set.title: Generalize chunk programs and deterministic reducers
